items.title: Pay outstanding balance for dining furniture
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie dringend, den Gesamtbetrag bis Freitag, 11.12.2026 zu begleichen.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for payment: 'bis Freitag, 11.12.2026'. Checked against the NW holiday calendar for 2026: 11 December 2026 is a Friday and not a public holiday, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. The due date is the date as printed.

warnings: This is the second reminder (2. Mahnung) from a furniture retailer, not a public authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies to it; the stated due date of 11.12.2026 is taken as printed.

The letter threatens to hand the claim to a debt-collection agency (Inkassounternehmen) at the person's cost if payment is not received by the due date — the person should verify this is a genuine follow-up to the earlier reminder of 04.11.2026 and that the invoice amount and delivery (15.10.2026) match their own records before paying.

The IBAN printed (DE67 3705 0198 0005 5770 00) is well-formed and matches the sender's name on the letterhead, but a well-formed IBAN does not prove account ownership; confirm it matches earlier correspondence from this company before transferring money.
